## Introduction

Playwright Test is an end-to-end test framework.

### Using npm, yarn or pnpm

<Tabs>
<TabItem value="npm" label="npm">

```bash
npm init playwright@latest
```

</TabItem>
<TabItem value="yarn" label="yarn">

```bash
yarn create playwright
```

</TabItem>
</Tabs>
